description: A town she works in, with its own page: a photo, a short guide, its homes for sale and recent sales. Homes link to a town through their Town field.

id.label: ID
id.help: Made from the name, e.g. san-carlos. It becomes the page address, /neighborhoods/san-carlos.

name.label: Name
name.help: The town's name. Shared by both languages.

image.label: Photo
image.help: A wide street or skyline photo for the top of the town's page and its card. Credit the photographer in the image's Credit field.

intro.label: Introduction
intro.help: A short paragraph on what it's like to live there.

knownFor.label: Known For
knownFor.help: One or two sentences: the town's character, where people walk and eat.

schools.label: Schools
schools.help: One or two sentences about the schools. Keep it general and factual.

commute.label: Commute
commute.help: One or two sentences: Caltrain, freeways, the drive to the City and to Palo Alto.

weekends.label: Weekends
weekends.help: One or two sentences: parks, farmers markets, trails.

metaDescription.label: Search Description
metaDescription.help: One sentence for search results, under 160 characters. Leave it empty and the start of the introduction is used.

sort.label: Order
sort.help: Lower numbers come first in lists and the footer.

seo.label: Search and Sharing
seo.help: How this page appears in search results and when shared, in English. Leave it empty and the page's own words are used. Spanish pages use the Spanish text from the fields above.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.
